title: CR-050 Rectification — Header cards not compact, only 1 item shown, manual-add still present

title: Add Stock — BATCH Enter Skips Date Field (keyup transfer bug)
notes: SpreadsheetRow: pressing Enter on batch field focuses the expiry date input. But Chromium fires keyup on the newly-focused element, so the date input's onKeyUp immediately fires handleKeyDown("expiry", Enter) → advances to next row before user types date. Fix: add justFocused ref in SpreadsheetRow; onFocus sets it true; onKeyUp skips if justFocused is true. Note: native <input type=date> sub-field (mm/dd/yyyy) navigation uses Tab/ArrowRight not Enter — cannot step through sub-fields with Enter without a custom picker. SMALL scope, 1 file ~5 lines.

title: Dispatch — Multi-Batch Source Selection Not Wired (FEFO multi-alloc broken)
notes: fefoAutoSelect() correctly computes multi-alloc (e.g. 5kg seg_A + 5kg seg_B). But autoSource=null when allocs>1 (line 221) → sourceSelector=null. The multi-batch <select> UI renders but onChange overwrites to a single segment_id (line 788). Payload sends source_selector:null for multi-batch items. Fix requires: (1) API probe — can items[] accept same source_inventory_master_id twice with different source_selector+qty? If yes → split multi-alloc into multiple payload items (Option B). If no → file G-040 (backend gap for array source_selector). API probe needs live dispatch test in dev env before PLANNING can proceed. MEDIUM scope.

title: Purchase Report — Fare Column Missing + Summary Excludes Fare (NO-CODE)
notes: Live API probe confirmed: PUR-828-20261020-8011 has tot_fair=200, tot_amount=1200, line_total=1000. Amount column (line 252) uses line_total (items only) — fare excluded. Summary total (line 55) uses d.total_amount (API root) which per G-038 = sum(line_totals), also excludes fare. Fix (when approved): (1) Add Fare column — show r.tot_fair on first row per transaction_id, dash elsewhere (avoids double-count on multi-item purchases). (2) Summary: deduplicate by transaction_id → sum unique tot_amount. SMALL scope 1 file ~15 lines. OWNER INSTRUCTION: NO-CODE, SKIP GATE — Gate 1 only until owner gives GO. Investigation complete: INVESTIGATION_20261020_BUG061_DESIGN.md — proposed transaction-grouped table design, fare pill on header, correctTotal useMemo. Awaiting owner GO for Planning+Implementation. | Design revision: Option B (dedicated Fare column) chosen by owner 2026-10-20. Plan: BUG-061_ARTIFACT_3b_IMPL_PLAN_OPTION_B.md

title: Dispatch — Source Selector Shows Only FEFO Batch (All Batches Not Selectable)
notes: The SOURCE (FEFO) <select> dropdown is built from fefoAllocs[] — only the FEFO-chosen batch appears as an option. segments_preview[] has all available batches but they are never offered as choices. Storekeeper cannot override FEFO and pick a different batch. Fix: replace fefoAllocs.map(<1-option select>) with a single <select> listing all segments_preview entries; FEFO batch pre-selected; onChange sets sourceSelector + sourceManuallySet=true. Add display_qty availability note when selected segment has less qty than send qty. When only 1 segment exists: static badge (no dropdown). SMALL scope, 1 file ~25 lines. Distinct from BUG-060 (multi-batch split). Investigation: INVESTIGATION_20261020_DISPATCH_SEGMENT_SELECTOR.md

title: Dispatch — Source Selector Too Small + Click Dead Zone (native <select> UX)
notes: 3 compounding causes: (1) h-6 (24px) native <select> too short — tiny hit target. (2) Native OS <select> widget: text area is not reliably clickable on all platforms (esp. macOS Chrome/Safari) — only the dropdown arrow triggers open. (3) disabled={!row.included} silently kills clicks on unchecked rows — storekeeper clicks the dropdown and nothing happens. Fix: replace native <select>/<option> with Shadcn <Select> (already imported line 14) — full-width <button> trigger, entirely clickable; increase to h-8; remove disabled={!row.included} (keep disabled={submitting} only, consistent with qty Input). 1 file, 1 region (~22 lines). RELATED: BUG-062 (same region, immediate follow-on).
